scope: Latin America existing 34 countries; excludes Mexico

regionPolygons.meaning: Natural Earth physical label areas. Approximate geographic name extents, not measured geomorphological boundaries or hydrological drainage basins. Label positions are editorial, source polygons are unchanged.

riverLines.geometry: Original paths clipped to display bounds; country outline masks Mexico. No inferred connectors, flow direction, discharge or hydrological basin. Existing 50m IDs retained by exact source name.
